exposure: Obstetricians' opinions on blood transfusion practices
Type of caesarean section (elective vs. emergency)
outcome: Rates of cross-matching blood for caesarean sections
Rates of arranging blood for caesarean sections
Rates of blood transfusion in elective caesarean sections
Rates of blood transfusion in emergency caesarean sections
cohort: The study surveyed 92 obstetricians in Pakistan who had completed post-graduation and were in practice for more than ten years.
finding: The study concluded that there is no need to cross-match and arrange blood for all caesarean sections, as only a small percentage of patients require transfusion, recommending that these practices should be reserved for selected high-risk patients.
mod_finding: Blood transfusion practices of consultants were different for elective and emergency caesarean sections, with all consultants transfusing blood in less than 30% of their elective caesarean sections and 90% in less than 30% of their emergency caesarean sections.
